title: QuranRoots
summary: An English and French Quran reading and learning experience.
detail: Reading, structured lessons, and progress tracking in one bilingual experience. Work includes interface improvements, production validation, security headers, and deployment workflows.

title: Shalom Enterprise
summary: A polished digital presence for a limousine service.
detail: A transport business website built around service discovery and reservations. The supplied portfolio describes an EmailJS reservation integration.

title: Chez Christian
summary: Turn ingredients into ideas for your next meal.
detail: An AI recipe application that helps users explore meals based on the ingredients they have available.

title: Assure Coaching
summary: A cohesive web experience for a coaching business.
detail: A redesign focused on clear content, responsive layouts, and consistent design across pages, including the blog experience.

title: Humble Delicacies
summary: A warm, distinctive website for an artisanal bakery.
detail: A bakery website presenting its products and brand, with ordering and delivery information described in the original portfolio.

title: Vivid Space Media
summary: Give real estate photography room to speak.
detail: A property photography portfolio designed around image presentation, service information, and an approachable brand experience.

title: Petite Focus
summary: A visual home for photographic storytelling.
detail: A photography portfolio that uses imagery and a restrained interface to showcase visual work.

title: OlaBank Dashboard
summary: Explore a banking dashboard through a focused interface.
detail: A banking dashboard interface project exploring financial information, visual hierarchy, and account controls. Presented as a portfolio interface, not a banking service.

title: AyoFlow
summary: A simple interface for organizing everyday tasks.
detail: A task management application exploring task organization and a streamlined productivity interface.

title: LangGuesser
summary: A programming language twist on Hangman.
detail: An interactive guessing game that uses programming language names as its theme, with a React interface and keyboard-style controls.

title: Guess Game
summary: Find the secret number, one guess at a time.
detail: A number guessing game exploring user input, feedback, scoring, and interactive game logic.

title: Pig Game
summary: A turn-based game of risk and reward.
detail: A dice game centered on turn-taking, accumulating points, and choosing when to hold a score.

title: Rock Paper Scissors
summary: A familiar game with a playful digital interface.
detail: A browser game built around player choices, computer responses, and outcome feedback.

title: Ubuntu Diaspora
summary: A community platform connecting the African diaspora.
detail: A community platform concept presented in the supplied portfolio. The attached materials include a preview image but no public project URL.

title: MediaVertex One
summary: A self-hosted media platform, built layer by layer.
detail: A portfolio and learning project progressing from Docker and Nginx toward a full media platform. The planned architecture includes React, Django REST, PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery, object storage, FFmpeg, and HLS. These are planned capabilities, not a completed production stack.

title: ReadyOps
summary: An operations product taking shape through research.
detail: An application concept developed through problem research and an initial interface direction. Product discovery and design are the current stage.

title: Vertex Studio
summary: A branded showcase for digital design and development.
detail: The original studio website supplied with this portfolio. It presents services, project categories, contact information, and a visual brand system.
